newsitem.title: USA: Ethan Allen Q2 margins improved. [CORRECTED 20:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Ethan Allen Q2 margins improved. [CORRECTED 20:15 GMT]

text.p: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc said on Thursday that it attributes increased second quarter earnings to improved wholesale and retail margins, continued growth in sales and lower interest expense.
Ethan Allen reported second quarter earnings of $0.84 (corrects from $0.94) a share on sales of $136.3 million, compared to $0.54 a share on sales of $127.2 million the previous second quarter.
The company said that its consumer focused marketing strategy continues to gain momentum.
